title: Kitchen notes, Week 8
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md: Updated Tue 7:55 PM ET: added Chig Okonkwo as an add and Quinshon Judkins as a hold, with Wednesday watches on Tyjae Spears, Elijah Mitchell and Jacoby Brissett. Updated Tue 7:45 PM ET: rest-of-season ranks refreshed throughout; the calls stand. Updated Tue 7:35 PM ET: added Antonio Williams and Omar Cooper Jr. as claims, Seth McGowan and Kaelon Black as stashes, and Wednesday-to-Friday practice watches on Breece Hall, Jeremiyah Love, Amon-Ra St. Brown, Emeka Egbuka, Jaylen Waddle and Ladd McConkey.

items.text: Tony Pollard (TEN) ran 25 times for 129 and 3 TDs vs CLE on 75 percent of the snaps with Tyjae Spears (knee) inactive, after 14 and 19 carries the two weeks before. Spears' return puts Pollard back on his Weeks 1 to 5 share, so trade Pollard away and ask for an RB2. Spears is RB59 rest of season for me. Monitor his practice participation Wednesday to Friday.
items.watch: Titans practice reports, Wednesday to Friday

items.text: Quinshon Judkins (CLE) ran 17 times for 96 and 2 TDs at TEN on 53 percent of the snaps, down from 66 percent in Week 4, as Dylan Sampson played 32 snaps in his first game since Week 1 and took the passing downs with 3 catches for 32. Judkins kept 17 carries to Sampson's 6 and both scores. Sampson is RB58 rest of season for me; monitor his carries Sunday at PIT. Judkins is RB22 rest of season for me. Hold him.
items.why: He kept the early downs and the goal line; Sampson past 10 carries at PIT, or Judkins under half the snaps, would change the call.

items.text: Chig Okonkwo (WAS) caught all 7 targets for 69 at SF in Week 6, after a team-high 6 targets vs NYG in Week 5, and Terry McLaurin's targets are now spread through the room. TE16 rest of season for me. Add him, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

Elijah Mitchell (PHI), elevated from the practice squad, played 14 snaps vs DAL Monday with 3 carries for 11 and 3 catches for 23, and he was the only Eagles back left after Dameon Pierce went down with an undisclosed injury. RB90 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Eagles injury report; he is a deep-league add only if Pierce is out.

Jacoby Brissett (ARI) started Week 7 vs DEN with Carson Beck's back acting up and threw 48 times, completing 27 for 272 and a TD. Arizona plays at DAL Sunday. QB29 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Cardinals practice report for Beck; if Brissett starts, he is a streamer at DAL.

Antonio Williams (WAS) played 45 snaps at SF in Week 6, the most of any Washington receiver, and caught 3 of 4 targets for 50. Dan Quinn said Monday he expects Williams to get more chances with Terry McLaurin out for the season. WR46 rest of season for me. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

Omar Cooper Jr. (NYJ) ran a route on 70 percent of the dropbacks vs MIA to Adonai Mitchell's 55 and caught 5 for 115 and a TD on 38 snaps. Garrett Wilson drew 3 targets on 50 snaps and stays WR17 rest of season for me; hold him. Cooper is WR35 rest of season for me. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent of FAAB.

Seth McGowan (IND) ran 11 times for 46 on 18 snaps vs MIN, both season highs, while Jonathan Taylor played 41 snaps and ran 18 times for 95 and a TD. Indianapolis traded Quenton Nelson to Seattle Tuesday, and reports say the Colts do not want to move Taylor but have not ruled it out before the Nov 10 deadline. Taylor is RB6 rest of season for me; hold him. McGowan is RB61 rest of season for me, a deadline bet and not a role. Stash him in deep leagues, 1 to 3 percent of FAAB.

Mike Macdonald said Zach Charbonnet (SEA), inactive in Week 7 with a knee issue, is trending toward his debut Monday vs CHI, and Jadarian Price (chest) will be designated to return from IR this week. Price is RB48 rest of season for me; keep him stashed. Charbonnet is RB37 rest of season for me. Monitor Seattle's practice reports, then Monday's inactives.
items.watch: Seattle's practice reports, then Monday's inactives vs CHI

items.text: Breece Hall (NYJ) missed his fourth straight game with the quad and is targeting a return Sunday vs LV. RB23 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Jets practice report.

Mike LaFleur said Jeremiyah Love (ARI) will practice Wednesday with the ankle after missing two games, with Sunday at DAL the target. RB21 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Cardinals practice report.

DJ Moore (BUF) missed Weeks 5 and 6 with a re-aggravated AC joint sprain before the Week 7 bye, and all signs point to him playing vs BAL Sunday. WR27 rest of season for me. Hold him; only a missed practice this week changes that.
items.why: He is expected back from the shoulder vs BAL; a missed practice this week would change the call.

items.text: Amon-Ra St. Brown (DET) tweaked an ankle in the 20-17 win over GB, and Dan Campbell said he should be ready to practice Thursday. WR4 rest of season for me. Monitor Thursday's Lions practice report.

Todd Bowles listed Emeka Egbuka (TB) as questionable for the Atlanta game with concussion and foot injuries and will know more after Wednesday and Thursday practice. WR33 rest of season for me. Monitor Thursday's Buccaneers practice report.

Jaylen Waddle (DEN) left late at ARI with chest and left shoulder injuries after a season-low 56 percent of the snaps, and his Week 8 status vs KC depends on Thursday and Friday practice. WR39 rest of season for me. Monitor Friday's Broncos injury report.

Ladd McConkey (LAC) worked in a non-contact jersey in Monday's bonus practice after the bye, still in the concussion protocol. WR34 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Chargers practice report for full contact.

Rashid Shaheed (SEA) left Week 7 vs KC with a knee injury after 22 snaps and 2 catches for 1 yard, and Mike Macdonald said he avoided the worst case. WR71 rest of season for me. Monitor Thursday's Seahawks practice report.

Brian Thomas Jr. (JAX) has played 43 percent of the snaps with 0 catches on 5 targets over his last two games, and Jacksonville is reported to be seriously considering a trade before the Nov 10 deadline. WR66 rest of season for me. Monitor the trade wire through Nov 10 at 4 PM ET.
items.watch: the trade wire through Nov 10 at 4 PM ET

items.text: Kaelon Black (SF) ran 12 times for 63 and his first career TD at ATL after Christian McCaffrey left briefly. McCaffrey's injury is a mild hamstring strain and he is on track for Week 9 vs LV after the bye; hold McCaffrey. Black is RB46 rest of season for me, a handcuff and not a weekly play. Stash him only in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.

Lamar Jackson (BAL) is expected to play Sunday at Buffalo, per Ian Rapoport, who said he is believed to be as close to 100 percent as he has been since the Week 4 high ankle sprain. He has missed three straight games. QB6 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Ravens practice report.

Matthew Golden (GB) did not take part in Tuesday's walkthrough with the shoulder and foot injuries, his second straight missed session before Thursday vs CAR. He drew 12 targets at DET in Week 7, and Tucker Kraft (TE8 rest of season for me) is next in line for looks. Golden is WR14 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's final Packers injury report.

Jalen Coker (CAR) was a full participant in Tuesday's practice with the shoulder, per ESPN's Mike Kaye, after a limited Monday. Carolina plays Thursday at Green Bay. WR20 rest of season for me. Hold him; only a downgrade on Wednesday's final report changes that.
items.why: Only a downgrade on Wednesday's final Carolina injury report changes the call.

items.text: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (NYG) went on injured reserve Tuesday with the hamstring he hurt at Houston, per the Giants' site, so he misses at least four games. Cam Skattebo keeps the backfield after the Week 8 bye. Tracy is RB63 rest of season for me. Drop him for any add on the wire.

Erick All Jr. (CIN) went on injured reserve Tuesday with the right knee he hurt in the win over Baltimore, and Ian Rapoport reported a torn ACL is feared, the third in that knee. Mike Gesicki is the tight end left standing in Cincinnati. All is TE53 rest of season for me. Drop him.

Jaylen Wright (MIA) left the win at the Jets with a quad injury after 8 snaps and 6 carries for 8 yards, and his Week 8 status vs NE is open. Ollie Gordon II played 83 percent of the snaps and ran 25 times for 103 and a TD. Wright is RB60 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Dolphins practice report.

Saquon Barkley (PHI) tweaked the hamstring on the first drive in his return vs DAL Monday, then hurt his back and did not play the fourth quarter of the 38-21 loss. He said neither injury should keep him out Sunday night vs WAS. RB18 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Eagles injury report.

Dameon Pierce (PHI) led the Eagles with 14 carries for 47 yards and a TD vs DAL Monday on 64 percent of the snaps, then left with 8:38 to go with an undisclosed injury and did not return. Tank Bigsby and Will Shipley are on IR and Carson Steele was waived injured Oct 20, so Elijah Mitchell, up from the practice squad, was the only back left (3 carries, 3 catches for 23 on 14 snaps); leave Mitchell on the wire until Pierce's diagnosis. Pierce is RB70 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's Eagles injury report.
